summary:
I accept revision 2 as the fairpane-spec reviewer. I made no repository changes and ran no shell, git, or test commands. I read the files at the current working tree. The reflog (.git/logs/HEAD) shows d185b5e as the FP-0003 commit, followed by six commits for FP-0033, FP-0047, the plan, and FP-0002. [INFERENCE] Going by their messages, none of them touches the FP-0003 files. I also ran read-only jq queries with the read tool against the stored manifest at .tools/corpora/wpt/MANIFEST.json.

The review-2 major finding is resolved:
- The `test262` items in the manifest sit under only two roots, `infrastructure` and `third_party`.
- Counted by file entry, they are 20 files and 20 items under infrastructure/test262/, 43 and 43 under third_party/test262/harness/ (including a harness/sm/ subdirectory), and 53597 and 53597 under third_party/test262/test/.
- These match specs/applicability/wpt.json, where the breakdown has `test262` 20, discovery is 76620 (76600 + 20), and `reported_separately.test262` has 53640 items with by_prefix 43 and 53597.
- Only the third_party/test262/ items are tied to vendored.toml revision 7ab7faf.
- The upstream rule checks out: `name_is_test262` is `"test262" in self.dir_path.split(os.path.sep) and self.ext == ".js"` (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/b60c4b349d9d167bf354a40bc0d4cbed15174606/tools/manifest/sourcefile.py, lines 428-431).
- The harness naming is correct. Test262 INTERPRETING.md at the vendored revision says `includes` files "are located within the `harness/` directory" (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tc39/test262/7ab7fafa0003f73fc85c1b95d88094d33f7eb8bd/INTERPRETING.md, lines 253-260).

The new import requirements check out against their primary sources:
- ucd/extracted/DerivedJoiningType.txt, ucd/IndicSyllabicCategory.txt, ucd/IndicPositionalCategory.txt, and uca/allkeys.txt all exist under https://www.unicode.org/Public/18.0.0/.
- UAX #44 says the DerivedJoiningType.txt values "should be taken as definitive".
- RFC 5892 A.1 and A.2 use Canonical_Combining_Class Virama and Joining_Type L, D, T, and R.
- UTS #46 §4.1 step 8 applies ContextJ when CheckJoiners is set, and the URL Standard sets CheckJoiners to true.
- The USE document derives classes from Joining_Type (AJT), Indic_Syllabic_Category (UISC), Indic_Positional_Category (UIPC), and General_Category (UGC), plus Microsoft's supplementary files.
- At CLDR release-48-2, common/uca/FractionalUCA.txt, allkeys_CLDR.txt, UCA_Rules.txt, common/collation/root.xml (an empty `standard` collation), and the three plural files all exist. FractionalUCA.txt states UCA=17.0.0, and allkeys_CLDR.txt states @version 17.0.0.
- UTS #35 Part 5 says the DUCET order is "slightly different from the CLDR root collation order".
- ECMA-402 recommends CLDR tailorings for CompareStrings and CLDR data for Intl.PluralRules, and it defines PluralRuleSelectRange.

Evidence at d185b5e:
- Gate receipts 2026-10-09T02-05-37 pass with source f1d4684f...; the controller-test log shows 107 tests, 107 passing.
- The last two runs in raw/corpus-verify.log (lines 148 and 182) are the exact acceptance commands. They exit 0 with no environment overrides and report WPT discovery of 76620.

No blocker or major finding remains. Four non-blocking findings remain, three minor and one note:
(a) The East_Asian_Width rule list is wrong. This error came from my own review-2 note.
(b) The text describing the upstream `test262` type omits the frontmatter and `_FIXTURE.js` conditions.
(c) The evidence README is stale about the revision-2 integration runs.
(d) The consumer descriptions for Bidi_Class and General_Category miss the UTS #46 uses.

Policy-root decision under specs/:
- I APPROVE the additions: specs/applicability/wpt.json as regenerated at d185b5e, specs/applicability/test262.json, specs/snapshots/test262.json, specs/snapshots/wpt.json, specs/README.md, specs/IMPORT_REQUIREMENTS.md, and specs/sources.json S25-S55.
- I APPROVE the proposed specs/corpora.json values in ADR 0003 (engineering/decisions/0003-corpus-snapshots.md:265-289). For test262 these are revision 2e0a5676..., license_record specs/snapshots/test262.json, inventory_sha256 4d86002f..., local_path <corpora-root>/test262/repository.git, and status pinned. For wpt they add manifest_sha256 86d55bee..., with revision b60c4b34... and inventory_sha256 0be4a67e....
- These values match the snapshot records and the 02:06 acceptance runs. pinProblems (tools/corpus.mjs:450-461) reads exactly these field names.
- The minor findings do not change any pinned value, count, or digest. If WPT_RULE is reworded, the integrator must regenerate specs/applicability/wpt.json, because verification compares the whole record. The manifest and inventory pins stay the same.

findings.issue: The row says UAX #14 uses East_Asian_Width 'directly in rules LB15a, LB15b, LB19, LB19a, LB21a, LB30, and LB30b'. In UAX #14 revision 57 (Unicode 18.0.0, https://www.unicode.org/reports/tr14/), $EastAsian appears only in LB19a and LB30. LB15a and LB15b use \p{Pi} and \p{Pf}, LB19 uses QU minus \p{Pi} or \p{Pf}, LB21a is 'HL (HY | HH) × [^HL]', and LB30b uses \p{Extended_Pictographic}&\p{Cn}. The UAX's parenthetical list covers rules that use any of East_Asian_Width, General_Category, or Extended_Pictographic. My review-2 note misread that list. The same text appears in specs/sources.json:306 (S37 purpose).
findings.recommendation: Say that East_Asian_Width is used directly in LB19a and LB30. Add General_Category (LB15a, LB15b, LB19, LB30b) to the UnicodeData.txt consumer column, or to a DerivedGeneralCategory row. Fix the S37 purpose to match.

findings.issue: WPT_RULE says 'Upstream assigns the "test262" type to every ".js" file with a "test262" directory component'. The same wording appears in corpus.mjs:262, the committed discovery.rule in specs/applicability/wpt.json, ADR 0003:208, sources.json:386 (S47), and CONTRACT.md:208. Upstream also requires parseable Test262 frontmatter and a name that does not end in `_FIXTURE.js`. Otherwise the file becomes a `support` item (sourcefile.py:1155-1162 and test262.py `parse` at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/b60c4b349d9d167bf354a40bc0d4cbed15174606/tools/manifest/test262.py). At the pin, infrastructure/test262/support/invalid-module.js, infrastructure/test262/support/module-helper.js, resources/test262/test262-{provider,reporter}.js, and the vendored *_FIXTURE.js files are `support` items. The operative rule, which uses the manifest type plus the path prefix, and every count are unaffected.
findings.recommendation: Reword to 'every ".js" file with a "test262" directory component that has Test262 frontmatter and whose name does not end in "_FIXTURE.js"; other such files are support items'. Then regenerate specs/applicability/wpt.json, because verification compares the whole record. Make the same change in ADR 0003:208, S47, and the corpus.mjs:262 comment. Leave the frozen contract text as is, or note the correction in the next revision.

findings.issue: The DerivedBidiClass.txt consumer names only UAX #9. The URL Standard also sets CheckBidi to true, and UTS #46 §4.1 step 9 then applies RFC 5893 §2, which needs Bidi_Class. Step 6 needs General_Category=Mark (https://www.unicode.org/reports/tr46/ §4.1; https://url.spec.whatwg.org/ 'domain parser ToASCII'). Both files are already listed, so there is no import gap.
findings.recommendation: Add 'UTS #46 CheckBidi (RFC 5893 §2) for URL host parsing' to the DerivedBidiClass row, and the General_Category leading-mark check to the UnicodeData row.
